description.value: Latin Square is a Latin American cafe and snack shop on Davie Street in Vancouver's West End, serving espresso drinks, frappes, and an eclectic roster of traditional foods from across the region — empanadas from Argentina, Colombia, Peru, and Chile, alongside tamales, arepas, churros, and tres leches cake. The shop also carries Latin grocery products and celebrates Latin American Independence events with themed specials. It bills itself as Vancouver's favourite Latin coffee shop and draws a lively neighbourhood crowd.
